question.text: For the purpose of computing Series NAV in a Cat III AIF, allocation of fund expenses (other than management fees) across different series is generally done:

answer.text: Equally among all series irrespective of size
In proportion to the Opening Series NAV of each series

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the chapter: 'Fund Expenses... that are not specifically attributable to a specific series of units shall generally be allocated amongst all the series and class of units, in proportion to the Opening Series NAV of each series issued by the Fund.' The Trap: Equal allocation ignores the relative size of each series; allocating only to the newest series or only to Class D (sponsor) units would shift the burden to a single sub-set of investors and contradicts the workbook's pro-rata rule. Note: The allocation key is the Opening Series NAV of each series, which is what the workbook prescribes for non-attributable fund expenses.
